$comment: Contract-shape ratchet (scripts/ci/check_contract_shape.py, ADR-0081). Numbers may only fall; raising one requires --write-baseline --reason, recorded in growth_reasons.

growth_reasons.production_lines: Keep typed continuation provenance beside MessageId minting and existing steer/report classifiers; seven net production lines after consolidating duplicate Session-scoped identity formatting. No new contract dependency, port, protocol field, or stored authority.

growth_reasons.catch_all_errors: merged awaken-environment-realization-contract; its 2 instances moved here, workspace total unchanged

growth_reasons.production_lines: single-source the realization-lease laws: SandboxEffectFence::for_operation and fence_is_live_at join the fence kernel in provisioning (+23); session-contract lease/generation rules now call that kernel instead of repeating the field comparison (+12 at three call sites, -6 projection)
growth_reasons.catch_all_errors: Classify/Disposition vocabulary moved down into agent-contract so sandbox failures classify without a provisioning->runtime edge; provisioning-contract gains the typed SandboxError classes and the neutral handle-evidence codec that replaced its backend payload enums (backend nouns 10->0); SandboxError Transport/Invalid are classified failure classes carrying detail, replacing the former untyped SandboxError(String)

growth_reasons.production_lines: Replace the last generic Resource Invalid payloads with domain causes and remove ResourceErrorDetail

Preserve the existing governed attempt closure contract and the exact Run selector on DispatchOperationalFeed; both reuse the canonical Dispatch owner. The dispatch deadline and claim guard judge through the one awaken_lease_contract::Expiry law (one import line).
growth_reasons.depth: Removing the compatibility facade exposes direct domain-owner dependencies; retaining explicit state, realization, runtime, and ingress boundaries avoids a replacement aggregator.

growth_reasons.production_lines: RetryPolicy regains a count bound for rate limits (throttled_max_retries, default 12) alongside the logical deadline, so an instant zero-pause 429 stops at its count while a long pause stops at the deadline; a field, a default constant and doc lines. AttemptQuiescence is the existing backend-neutral live handle in RuntimeRunContext, shared by Native, ACP and A2A. Its 49-line closure extension reuses pinned Tokio TaskTracker and CancellationToken instead of a custom counter; putting the concrete handle in Runtime would create a contract-to-implementation cycle. No contract graph, backend vocabulary, persisted state or wire surface is added.

growth_reasons.catch_all_errors: Extract immutable Session configuration and its resolution ports behind one authoritative owner during facade removal
